description: Check whether a custom domain is wired up and serving yet — the verify/poll half of the custom-domain flow. After you give the user the DNS records (get_domain_setup) and they attach the domain + add the records, call this to see live progress: is it attached to the CloudSite, does DNS resolve to the GearHost node, and is HTTPS active. Identify the site by token or name+project_key. Poll this every ~30-60s after the user adds DNS until https:"active" — like get_site_status for a publish. Returns structuredContent { status, domain, attached, dns_ok, apex_ok, www_ok, https, live, live_url, next }.

domain.description: The custom domain to check, e.g. "yourshop.com".

name.description: The site name (with project_key) instead of a token.

project_key.description: The project_key (with name) instead of a token.

token.description: The site manage token (or use name+project_key).

name: get_domain_status

attached.description: True if the domain is attached to your CloudSite (done in the Octane dashboard via Attach Custom Domain).

claim_url.description: If the site is unclaimed, surface this so the user can claim it before attaching. null if already claimed.

dns_ok.description: True if DNS for the apex OR www resolves to your GearHost site.

https.description: "active" (serving over HTTPS), "provisioning" (DNS resolves, cert issuing), or "waiting_dns" (records not visible yet).

next.description: The single next action to get it live.

requires_account.description: Always true — if not attached yet, the attach is done in the user's Octane account, not via the API.

title: Check custom domain status
